scope: 60-minute Android Flutter emulator background lifecycle test: microphone foreground-service state under Home + AVD screen-off, lifecycle-aware wake/resume, audio UI assertions, and normal leave/logout cleanup. No independent receiving participant or audible media acceptance.

environment.microphone_permission: Granted by the isolated QA runner

background_observation.scope: Microphone foreground service state while the app was backgrounded and the AVD screen was asleep

after_resume.foreground_state_line: isForeground=true foregroundId=9751 types=0x00000080 foregroundNoti=Notification(channel=boohtacord_voice_microphone shortcut=null contentView=null vibrate=null sound=null defaults=0 flags=ONGOING_EVENT|ONLY_ALERT_ONCE|FOREGROUND_SERVICE color=0x00000000 category=call vis=PRIVATE)

integration_runner.lifecycle_helper: Waited for AppLifecycleState.resumed (up to 75 minutes) before widget interaction after the background interval.

generic_runtime_report.scope: Android RNNoise microphone capture in an owned LiveKit room; physical acoustic quality not tested

unit_test.result: 2 passed: waits until resumed; fails with bounded timeout when resume never occurs.

post_leave_cleanup.observation_method: Read-only adb dumpsys/pidof checks after runner completed normal leaveVoice/logout; MicrophoneService match and app PID were absent.

visual_review.observation: At source resolution, the returned app shows the Audio Settings screen, RNNoise 0.1 selected and active, with the connected Voice dock showing one participant. No visible defect observed in this capture.

limitations: This is AOSP emulator evidence, not physical Android device acceptance; OEM power management and secure keyguard behavior were not verified.
The run does not establish intelligible microphone transmission, receiver RTP, decoded audio, or audible output; the emulator input level was zero and there was no independent receiver.
The screen-off state is verified; secure keyguard lock remains NOT_VERIFIED.
Flutter release merged manifest/APK and production smoke remain unverified because release signing credentials/keystore are unavailable.
iOS audio session/device acceptance and the physical Android+iOS paired 60-minute audible gate remain NOT_RUN.
Wi-Fi/LTE, airplane mode, permission revoke, OS/FGS stop, incoming call, battery saver, listener-only audio, Bluetooth routing, and Safari/PWA matrix remain NOT_RUN.
Issue #785 remains open; this scoped result does not close its release gate.
prior_failed_attempt_record: evidence/qa/issue785-android-flutter-fgs-background-hour-2026-11-18.json; the earlier harness timed out in pumpAndSettle after resume and did not perform leave/logout. This rerun records the lifecycle-aware fix and successful cleanup.
